config.treatment: only the reputation weight w differs across arms; init, N, rounds, mutation, generations, seeds identical

verdicts.label: P1
verdicts.gate: P1 no-reputation collapse: w=0 steady q̄ < 0.15 AND p̄ < 0.20 (evolution toward the rational near-0 offer)

verdicts.label: P2
verdicts.gate: P2 reputation -> fairness: w=1.0 steady q̄ > 0.30 AND p̄ > 0.30 (offers rise toward a fair split)

verdicts.label: P3
verdicts.gate: P3 reputation is the cause: (q̄ at w>=0.8) - (q̄ at w=0) >= 0.20 AND q̄ non-decreasing across w in {0, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0}
